notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
